title: AhaPro: A Process-level Rebus benchmark for probing Aha moments in LLM reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing research on Aha moments in large language models has largely focused on reflective expressions or final revision outcomes, leaving their role in the visible reasoning process insufficiently characterized. Rebus puzzles encode answers through character forms, spatial arrangements, and homophony. Reinterpreting key details may trigger Aha moments and shifts in the reasoning process and candidate answers. We introduce AhaPro, a process-level benchmark that uses rebus puzzles to examine how models reorganize evidence and revise answers through Aha moments. The framework represents CoT as sequences of candidate answers, evidence, and verification states, using hierarchical metrics to assess conflict detection, state improvement, and subsequent adoption. Across eleven models, we observe frequent failures to adopt better states discovered during Aha moments, alongside adopted revisions that leave state quality unchanged or reduce it.

translated_title: AhaPro：一个用于探测大语言模型推理中“顿悟”时刻的过程级字谜基准
translated_abstract: 现有关于大语言模型“顿悟”时刻的研究大多聚焦于反思性表达或最终修正结果，对其在可见推理过程中所扮演的角色刻画不足。字谜通过字形、空间排列和谐音来编码答案，对关键细节的重新解读可能触发“顿悟”时刻，并引发推理过程与候选答案的转变。我们提出了AhaPro，一个利用字谜来考察模型如何通过“顿悟”时刻重组证据并修正答案的过程级基准。该框架将思维链表示为候选答案、证据与验证状态的序列，并采用分层指标来评估冲突检测、状态改进及后续采纳情况。在十一个模型上的实验中，我们观察到模型经常未能采纳在“顿悟”时刻发现的更优状态，而已采纳的修正有时使状态质量保持不变甚至降低。
tldr: 本文提出基于字谜的过程级基准AhaPro来探测大语言模型推理中的“顿悟”时刻，发现模型常常未能采纳顿悟中发现的更优状态，且已采纳的修正甚至可能无益或有害。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AhaPro, a process-level rebus benchmark for probing Aha moments in LLM reasoning, revealing that models frequently fail to adopt better states discovered during Aha moments, while adopted revisions may leave state quality unchanged or even degrade it.
